store.name: Elona's Toys
store.tagline: Your One-Stop Kids Store — Toys & Essentials — Quality You Can Trust
store.location: Khaldeh, facing/beside Rammal Supermarket (QFPH+QQV, Khalde), Lebanon

products.name: Teddy Bear Plush
products.description: Soft cuddly teddy bear — perfect first friend for your little one.
products.descriptionAr: دباديب ناعم ومميز — الصديق الأول المثالي لصغيرك.
products.details: Perfect for newborns and infants. Soft, cuddly, and safe for snuggling. Machine washable on gentle cycle. Suitable for ages 0–12 months.

products.name: Building Blocks Set
products.description: Colorful wooden blocks for stacking, sorting, and early learning.
products.descriptionAr: مكعبات خشبية ملونة للترتيب والتصنيف والتعلم المبكر.
products.details: Stack, sort, and build to develop fine motor skills and early learning. Wash blocks with mild soap and water. Recommended for ages 1–3 years.

products.name: Race Car
products.description: Zoom around the room with this sturdy die-cast race car.
products.descriptionAr: انطلق في الغرفة مع سيارة السباق المعدنية المتينة هذه.
products.details: Wind up or push and watch it race. Great for hand-eye coordination and active play. Not suitable for children under 3. Ages 3–5 years.

products.name: Fashion Doll
products.description: Stylish doll with changeable outfits for hours of pretend play.
products.descriptionAr: دمية أنيقة مع ملابس قابلة للتغيير لساعات من اللعب التمثيلي.
products.details: Change outfits, style hair, and enjoy hours of pretend play. Ideal for ages 6–8 years. Brush hair gently with a soft brush.

products.name: ABC Blocks
products.description: Learn letters and colors with these classic alphabet blocks.
products.descriptionAr: تعلم الحروف والألوان مع مكعبات الأبجدية الكلاسيكية هذه.
products.details: Learn letters, colors, and spelling. Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Ages 0–12 months and up.

products.name: Monster Truck
products.description: Big wheels, big fun — the ultimate monster truck for crashing and racing.
products.descriptionAr: عجلات كبيرة، متعة كبيرة — شاحنة وحش نهائية للتحطم والسباق.
products.details: Big wheels for crashing and racing fun. Requires 2 AA batteries (not included). Ages 6–8 years.

products.name: Kitchen Play Set
products.description: Mini kitchen with pots, pans, and play food for little chefs.
products.descriptionAr: مطبخ مصغر مع أواني وأطعمة لعب للطهاة الصغار.
products.details: Mini pots, pans, and play food for little chefs. Encourages imaginative role-play. Wipe clean after use. Ages 3–5 years.

products.name: Outdoor Swing Set
products.description: Backyard swing set with slide — hours of outdoor fun.
products.descriptionAr: مجموعة أرجوحة في الفناء الخلفي مع منزلقة — ساعات من المتعة في الهواء الطلق.
products.details: Backyard swing set with slide. Adult assembly required. Anchor to ground before use. Ages 9+ years.

products.name: Puzzle Map
products.description: World map puzzle — learn geography while playing.
products.descriptionAr: أحجية خريطة العالم — تعلم الجغرافيا أثناء اللعب.
products.details: World map puzzle to learn geography. 48 large pieces for small hands. Store in the box when not in use. Ages 6–8 years.

products.name: Ride-On Car
products.description: Battery-powered ride-on car for adventures around the driveway.
products.descriptionAr: سيارة ركوب تعمل بالبطارية للمغامرات حول الممر.
products.details: Battery-powered ride-on car. Charge battery fully before first use. Supervise at all times. Ages 3–5 years.

products.name: Baby Rattle Set
products.description: Colorful rattles for sensory development in newborns.
products.descriptionAr: محضرات ملونة للتطور الحسي عند حديثي الولادة.
products.details: Colorful rattles for sensory development. BPA-free and easy to grip. Sterilize before first use. Ages 0–12 months.

products.name: Art & Craft Kit
products.description: Complete art set with paints, brushes, and canvas for young artists.
products.descriptionAr: مجموعة فنية كاملة مع ألوان وفرش وقماش للفنانين الصغار.
products.details: Complete art set with paints, brushes, and canvas. Protect work surfaces. Wash brushes after use. Ages 9+ years.

products.name: Musical Xylophone
products.description: Colorful xylophone for early music exploration.
products.descriptionAr: خشابة ملونة لاستكشاف الموسيقى في مرحلة الطفولة المبكرة.
products.details: Colorful xylophone for early music exploration. Tap gently with the included mallet. Ages 1–3 years.

products.name: Dino Action Figure
products.description: Roaring T-Rex action figure for prehistoric adventures.
products.descriptionAr: تمثال ديناصور تيرانوصور Rex للمغامرات ما قبل التاريخ.
products.details: Roaring T-Rex action figure for prehistoric adventures. Great for imaginative play. Ages 3–5 years.

products.name: Doctor Play Set
products.description: Pretend doctor kit with stethoscope, syringe, and bandages.
products.descriptionAr: مجموعة طبيب تخيلية مع سماعة أذن وحقنة ولاصقات.
products.details: Pretend doctor kit with stethoscope, syringe, and bandages. Wipe clean after play. Ages 3–5 years.

products.name: Math Learning Board
products.description: Wooden board for practicing addition, subtraction, and multiplication.
products.descriptionAr: لوحة خشبية لممارسة الجمع والطرح والضرب.
products.details: Wooden board for practicing addition, subtraction, and multiplication. Use with dry-erase marker. Ages 6–8 years.

products.name: Snakes and Ladders
products.description: Classic family board game for game night fun.
products.descriptionAr: لعبة لوحية عائلية كلاسيكية لليالي المرح.
products.details: Classic family board game for game night fun. For 2–4 players. Ages 6–8 years.

products.name: Balance Bike
products.description: No-pedal balance bike to learn coordination before riding.
products.descriptionAr: دراجة توازن بدون دوالات لتعلم التنسيق قبل الركوب.
products.details: No-pedal balance bike to learn coordination. Always wear a helmet. Adjust seat height as child grows. Ages 3–5 years.

products.name: Baby Teether Toy
products.description: Safe silicone teether for teething babies.
products.descriptionAr: لعاب سيليكون آمن للأطفال في مرحلة التسنين.
products.details: Safe silicone teether for teething babies. Sterilize before each use. Chill in fridge (not freezer) for soothing relief. Ages 0–12 months.

products.name: Remote Control Car
products.description: Fast RC car with working lights and sounds.
products.descriptionAr: سيارة RC سريعة مع أضواء وأصوات تعمل.
products.details: Fast RC car with working lights and sounds. Requires batteries (not included). Outdoor use recommended. Ages 9+ years.

products.name: Kids Lunch Box
products.description: Colorful insulated lunch box for school snacks.
products.descriptionAr: صندوق غداء ملون معزول للوجبات المدرسية.
products.details: Colorful insulated lunch box for school snacks. Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Not for microwave use. Ages 3–5 years.
